title: 高分突破精選字彙 (TOEIC 780-900) - 第 2 單元 (401~800 字)

words.definitionZh: 生態的; 生態學的

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: Maintaining a ecological working arrangement enables our team to respond swiftly to unexpected client demands.
examples.zh: 保持【生態的】的工作安排，使我們團隊能迅速回應突發的客戶需求。

examples.en: The chief executive officer delivered a ecological presentation outlining our long-term sustainable growth model.
examples.zh: 執行長發表了一場【生態的】的簡報，概述了我們長期的永續成長模式。

examples.en: Establishing ecological commercial partnerships is vital for expanding our enterprise footprint in foreign markets.
examples.zh: 建立【生態的】的商業合作夥伴關係，對於在海外市場拓展企業版圖至關重要。

quizzes.stem: The board of directors commended the cross-functional team for their _____ performance during the product launch.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 董事會讚揚了跨部門團隊在產品發表期間展現之【生態的】績效表現。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「生態的」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。

quizzes.stemTranslation: 在該商務備忘錄中，單字「ecological」（【生態的】）的意思與下列何者最接近？

quizzes.stem: The executive management committee agreed to _____ the client's urgent proposal after a detailed evaluation.
